title: Discovery & Brief
description: We begin with a detailed site visit and client consultation to understand your lifestyle, requirements, budget, and vision for the space.

title: Concept & Design
description: We present 2D floor plans, 3D visualisations, material boards, and colour palettes — refined through your feedback until the design is exactly right.

title: Execution & Supervision
description: Our team manages vendors, site supervision, and quality checks through every stage — from civil work to final styling — ensuring zero compromise on quality.

title: Handover & After-care
description: We do a formal snag walk with you, address every item on the punch list, and provide after-care support for 6 months post-completion.
